EXP_OFFSET and OFFSET_MAX declare u32 and carry values 12 to 187 digits wide. Newly DETECTED, not newly broken: the constants are unchanged and three backends still emit them verbatim -- only cc ever said so. The header says E_t = round((N-1)/phi^2) = 391, so which number is meant is a question about the format, not the compiler.
